YUBASE 4 is listed as an SK grade on the same site's SDS page. Not stated in the archived NARMAK TRADE property sheet. Supersedes the brand-level SK Enmove page and the third-party SlideShare copy of SK Corporation's 2000 paper (slide 10), which agrees (2026-10 audit).

Previously sourced to a third-party SlideShare copy of the 1999 SK Corporation MSDS No. 739-YU4-02 (same composition). Not stated in the archived NARMAK TRADE sheet DL2-11304.pdf (2026-10 audit).
